title: Keep only the polished words
quote: We don't need my original wording stored exactly; store only the polished version, as long as it stays clear and close to what I originally meant.
means: Only the polished words are kept, clear and close to your original intent: in every decision, intent source and session ask, the clean essence replaces what was typed.

supersedes.what: D-35 kept your words twice; only the polished words are kept.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-36 that held
